articles.title: Russian warship participates in Indian naval drills (VIDEO)
articles.summary: A Russian frigate, the Marshal Shaposhnikov, participated in the Indian Navy's flagship MILAN 2026 multilateral exercise. This biennial event saw representatives from over 70 countries, highlighting extensive international naval cooperation and interoperability. For SSB aspirants, this showcases India's commitment to maritime security and its role in fostering global defence diplomacy through joint exercises.

articles.title: Robert Carradine, ‘Revenge of the Nerds’ and ‘Lizzie McGuire’ Star, Dies at 71
articles.summary: Actor Robert Carradine, renowned for his roles in "Revenge of the Nerds," "The Long Riders," and "Lizzie McGuire," has passed away. His death followed a two-decade battle with Bipolar Disorder. Carradine's extensive career left a significant mark on film and television, and his passing brings attention to the persistent challenges faced by individuals struggling with mental health conditions.

articles.title: Woman in Tehran praises students for reigniting protests after bloody crackdown
articles.summary: Large-scale protests have erupted across multiple Iranian universities as the new academic year commenced. This marks the first sustained campus unrest since the clerical regime's nationwide crackdown, indicating potential renewed domestic challenges for Iran. These developments highlight ongoing internal dynamics, relevant for understanding regional stability and international relations.

articles.title: Air Ambulance with 7 on board crashes in Jharkhand shortly after takeoff to Delhi
articles.summary: An air ambulance carrying seven people tragically crashed in Jharkhand shortly after takeoff while en route to Delhi. This domestic incident highlights immediate concerns regarding aviation safety and the well-being of those aboard. Authorities are expected to launch a comprehensive investigation into the cause, underscoring the critical importance of stringent safety protocols in civilian air operations and emergency transport services.
